name: streamer-camera-snapshotter
description: Headless-browser WHEP consumer for match_options.streamer_camera_enabled -- pulls a player's camera feed from mediamtx-camera and serves it as periodic JPEG snapshots instead of live video, so the game-streamer pod (which may be on an unreliable/restrictive network for raw WebRTC) never has to be a WebRTC client itself. See DEAFCS/deafcs-web#91.
